verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official Granola command-line tool. The pack shows a REST API, an MCP server, Zapier, HubSpot and CSV export, but these are adjacent programmatic-access features or developer building blocks, not a CLI. An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS note-taking product, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
